meta.title: Vista Eye Specialist — Digital Transformation Roadmap
meta.prepared: Caspian Digital Solutions · September 2026 · revised 9 November 2026
meta.premise: Pre-launch runs 9 November to 31 December 2026. In-market Month 1 is January 2027. Website go-live is 22 January 2027, with a fallback of 22 February. Delivery team defined by role.

objectives.name: One lead definition, one cost per booked appointment
objectives.why: At the moment, Vista has five different lead counts, the website conversion metric has already been redefined twice, and campaign reporting does not connect through to revenue. A booked appointment is not a paying patient: some bookings never become a visit, and payment is not in the data yet. Until there is one agreed lead definition, and cost per booked appointment sits beside cost per attended visit, it is difficult to judge campaign performance fairly. Cost per booked appointment is not cost per paying patient. Payment and attended-visit cost are reported once that data exists.
objectives.measure: One reconciled lead ledger connecting platform → Respond.io → booking system, published monthly from Month 2. Cost per booked appointment to be reported from Month 2, using the current baseline of RM182 from Jan–Aug 2026. Cost per booked appointment is not cost per paying patient. Payment and attended-visit cost are reported once that data exists.
objectives.owner: Analytics Lead. Executive sponsor: Head of Digital Solutions (the Vista leader accountable for this result)

objectives.name: A new website that is fast, trilingual and built to convert
objectives.why: The current website has 101 location URLs across 16 branches, no consent layer, a 3.08 MB homepage, between 12 and 38 serious accessibility issues per template, and no new website articles in the sitemap since 2024. In its current form, it does not meet the RFP’s own acceptance criteria. We should also keep this as one website, not two. The same site can rank separately for every page and location, while a dedicated Happenings section can carry news and updates without creating a second domain or requiring a second KKLIU licence.
objectives.measure: New headless website live by 22 January 2027, hosted on AWS Malaysia, with 16 canonical branch pages, EN / BM / ZH with hreflang, CMP live, a Lighthouse score of 90 or above, WCAG 2.2 AA audited, and Core Web Vitals field p75 rated Good by Month 6.

objectives.name: Turn the enquiries Vista already receives into booked visits
objectives.why: The biggest issue is not necessarily getting more enquiries. It is converting the enquiries Vista already has. Unpaid enquiries currently book at 14.4%, while paid enquiries book at only 1.5%. Warm-to-Hot conversion sits between 21% and 33% each month. The AI assistant also cannot currently answer a price question properly, and the auto-close process is creating avoidable “Inactive” losses.
objectives.measure: Paid ads booking rate from 1.5% to at least 4% by Month 6 and at least 6% by Month 12. Warm-to-Hot conversion of at least 40% by Month 6. Zero after-hours red-flag cases left unread beyond 9 am the next day.
objectives.owner: Account Manager with Vista CS Lead. Support: Analytics Lead

objectives.name: Be found for cataract, LASIK and every Vista centre
objectives.why: Organic search is currently one of Vista’s strongest-engagement channels, but it is not being properly reported on. Content has also been published in batches and appears to have stopped in May 2026. At the same time, AI referral traffic has already started, with 282 sessions recorded, but this is not yet being actively measured or managed.
objectives.measure: Organic sessions +40% on the post-launch baseline by Month 12. 52 medically reviewed articles. At least 60% of tracked keywords on page 1. Local-pack top 3 positions for priority centre × service combinations. AI visibility across at least 5 engines by Month 12.

objectives.name: Put media spend where the bookings are actually coming from
objectives.why: Media decisions should be based on confirmed bookings, not platform numbers alone. At present, Google “conversions” include 23–52% Performance Max activity, often at a much lower cost than a genuine enquiry, while Meta “results” are currently producing only a 1.5% booking rate. TikTok is also the cheapest channel, but there is no clear plan for how it should be tested or used.
objectives.measure: Every campaign optimised towards a CRM-verified booking signal by Month 4. Cost per appointment reduced by 25% by Month 12, compared with the Month 4 baseline. TikTok and LinkedIn decisions based on pilot results and actual evidence, not assumptions.

objectives.name: Keep things fixed once they are fixed
objectives.why: Vista currently has 345 open action items with no clear closure status, while monthly reports often show numbers without enough analysis or follow-through. The same issues keep appearing because there is no clear process to close actions and confirm they are resolved.
objectives.measure: One monthly strategy meeting, with the pre-read shared 2 days before and the minutes and actions issued 1 day after. An action closure rate of at least 90%. A quarterly steering committee supported by market research. The Command Centre live from go-live.
objectives.owner: Programme Manager. Executive sponsor: Head of Digital Solutions (the Vista leader accountable for this result)

risks.r: Handover from the current agency, which holds GA4, Ads, Meta, GTM and Respond.io admin access and the reporting
risks.mit: Access checklist in the award letter; Gate 0 blocks Discovery until Vista-owned accounts are confirmed; the current agency kept on a 30-day read-only handover if needed
risks.fallback: Rebuild GA4 property and ad accounts from scratch under Vista ownership; accept 2–3 weeks' history gap

risks.r: Go-live (22 Jan) collides with CNY campaign (6–7 Feb)
risks.mit: Gate 5 on 15 Jan is a hard decision point; CNY landing pages built on both legacy and new site
risks.fallback: Go-live moves to 22 Feb; CNY runs on hardened legacy site with new tracking already live via GTM

risks.r: Vista clinical review latency stalls content and site copy
risks.mit: Named reviewers and 5-business-day SLA in the governance charter; calendar one month ahead; clinical advisor pre-reviews
risks.fallback: Publish non-clinical content (branch, doctor, FAQ) first; escalate at monthly meeting

risks.r: The media budget reduces materially against the current run-rate — lead volume optics fall before quality shows
risks.owner: Paid Media Lead · Head of Digital Solutions
risks.mit: Reporting switches to cost per booked appointment from Month 2; reserve and seasonal top-ups pre-agreed
risks.fallback: Vista tops up evergreen from the seasonal reserve; cost per lead is never reported without the booking rate beside it

risks.r: Respond.io admin access refused or delayed
risks.mit: Gate 0 condition; owner-level access requested in writing on award
risks.fallback: Vista CRM owner executes changes from CDS specifications under a change log

risks.r: KKLIU approval cycle delays campaigns and creative
risks.owner: Social Media Lead · Paid Media Lead
risks.mit: Approval-trail workflow; creative pipeline 6 weeks ahead; compliant claim library replaces 'Top #1', 'guaranteed', 'painless'
risks.fallback: Run approved evergreen creative; hold seasonal until approved

risks.mit: Two engineers on every component; IaC and documentation from Week 2
risks.fallback: CDS bench developer added within 5 business days

risks.r: Storyblok editorial region outside Malaysia; PDPA sensitivity
risks.mit: Editorial content only in Storyblok; all lead and patient data in AWS Malaysia; sub-processor list disclosed
risks.fallback: Self-hosted CMS option priced at Gate 1 if Vista requires

risks.r: Bot and data-centre traffic distorts the new baseline
risks.mit: Exclusions and bot filter in GA4 rebuild; confidence labels

risks.r: Renewal decision left to the last month
risks.mit: Terms tabled 30 Jul; decision requested 31 Aug; Year-2 plan at SteerCo 4
risks.fallback: Month-to-month extension clause; 30-day transition-out already in the proposal

risks.r: Price conflicts between branches (LASIK RM1,998 vs RM2,198 Cheras, and others)
risks.mit: One confirmed price list with inclusions before any price is published
risks.fallback: Run without a price line until Vista confirms the figure for that branch

risks.r: Doctor availability over CNY, Raya and ESCRS
risks.mit: Filming days and campaign talent booked around those windows
risks.fallback: Facility and equipment stories, not doctor-led, in those weeks

risks.r: A branch relocation (Kuantan / SES) changes the 15-branch list
risks.mit: Branch list confirmed in the first weeks; pages are data, not hard-coded
risks.fallback: Keep the live page live until the new address is confirmed

risks.r: Hungry Ghost Month (August) is a low season
risks.mit: Lighter August activity in the calendar
risks.fallback: Shift that week's weight into July or September

risks.mit: PDPA check before any reactivation send
risks.fallback: Do not send. Build the consented list forward.

checkpoints.what: Mid-campaign review; reserve released here in Vista's Q1 plan
